headline: Metropolis Healthcare posts 43 percent jump in Q2 net profit
hook: Higher test volumes and specialty growth drive profit
summary: Metropolis Healthcare reported a 43.2% year-on-year increase in second-quarter net profit to ₹75.3 crore, driven by a 15.8% rise in revenue to ₹496.8 crore. Patient volumes and test counts grew by 10% and 11% respectively, while specialty test revenue expanded by 20%. The diagnostics chain's board also declared an interim dividend of ₹1 per share, setting November 9 as the record date. Retail investors tracking healthcare diagnostics can note stronger operational volumes.
why_it_matters: Stronger diagnostic volumes signal robust earnings for healthcare sector holders.
winners_losers: Metropolis shareholders gain / rivals face volume comparison pressure
